mapper.select: SELECT l.id,l.tenant_id,l.requisition_id,l.line_no,l.material_id,l.quantity,l.issued_quantity, m.code material_code,m.name material_name,m.model material_model,m.unit, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(r.remaining_quantity) FROM inv_reservation r WHERE r.tenant_id=l.tenant_id AND r.requisition_line_id=l.id),0) reserved_quantity FROM inv_requisition_line l JOIN inv_material m ON m.tenant_id=l.tenant_id AND m.id=l.material_id WHERE l.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND l.requisition_id=#{id} ORDER BY l.line_no,l.id

SELECT r.id,r.tenant_id,r.requisition_id,r.requisition_line_id,r.balance_id,r.quantity, r.remaining_quantity,r.created_at,m.name material_name,b.name bin_name,pc.code batch_code FROM inv_reservation r JOIN inv_balance s ON s.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND s.id=r.balance_id JOIN inv_material m ON m.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND m.id=s.material_id JOIN inv_bin b ON b.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND b.id=s.bin_id LEFT JOIN inv_batch pc ON pc.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND pc.id=s.batch_id WHERE r.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND r.requisition_id=#{id} AND r.remaining_quantity>0 ORDER BY r.created_at,r.id

SELECT i.id,i.tenant_id,i.code,i.requisition_id,i.company_id,i.warehouse_id,i.confirmation_key, i.preview_fingerprint,i.total_amount,i.actor_id,i.actor_name,i.created_at,i.reversed, i.group_id,i.status,i.source_kind,i.row_version,i.deleted,i.confirmed_at,i.purpose, i.remark,i.department_id,i.recipient_id,i.recipient_name,i.task_kind,i.task_id, i.legacy_fingerprint,g.code group_code FROM inv_issue i LEFT JOIN inv_issue_group g ON g.tenant_id=i.tenant_id AND g.id=i.group_id WHERE i.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND (i.requisition_id=#{id} OR EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM inv_issue_allocation a JOIN inv_requisition_line l ON l.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND l.id=a.requisition_line_id WHERE a.tenant_id=i.tenant_id AND a.issue_id=i.id AND l.requisition_id=#{id})) ORDER BY i.created_at,i.id

SELECT a.id,a.tenant_id,a.issue_id,a.requisition_line_id,a.reservation_id,a.balance_id, a.cost_layer_id,a.quantity,a.amount,a.unit_cost,a.returned_quantity,a.returned_amount, a.used_quantity,a.outbound_line_id,m.name material_name,b.name bin_name,pc.code batch_code FROM inv_issue_allocation a JOIN inv_requisition_line l ON l.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND l.id=a.requisition_line_id JOIN inv_balance s ON s.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND s.id=a.balance_id JOIN inv_material m ON m.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND m.id=s.material_id JOIN inv_bin b ON b.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND b.id=s.bin_id LEFT JOIN inv_batch pc ON pc.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND pc.id=s.batch_id WHERE a.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND l.requisition_id=#{id} ORDER BY a.id
